# Drawing scripts of the raster driver tests. The language is the one of
# internal/klimt/svg/svgtest/script.go, with these settings and commands:
#
#   opt size W H        image size in pixels (200 x 100 by default)
#   opt back COLOR      image background (white by default)
#   opt dpi F           dpi factor of the graphic (1 by default)
#   aa on|off           UAntiAliasing
#   pattern NAME        UPattern (FULL, HORIZONTAL_STRIPE, ...)
#
# testdata/javagen/G2dGolden.java draws the same scripts with upstream's
# UGraphicG2d and writes golden/<case>.png; g2d_test.go draws them with
# this package and compares the images (size and SSIM).

case rect-basic
color #181818
translate 10 10
rect 60 30
translate 70 0
bg #FEFECE
rect 50.5 30.25
reset
color #A80036
bg #E2E2F0
translate 20.3 55.6
rect 40.4 25.7
translate 60 0
bg #FFAAAA
color #FFAAAA
rect 30 20
write

case rect-rounded
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
translate 10 10
rect 60 40 5
translate 70 0
rect 50 40 12.5
translate 60 0
stroke 2
rect 45.5 35.5 25
reset
translate 15 60
color #3333AA
bg #CCCCFF
rect 170 30 30
write

case rect-thick
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
stroke 2
translate 10 10
rect 50 30
stroke 3
translate 60 0
rect 50 30
stroke 0.5
translate 60 0
rect 50 30
stroke 1.5
reset
translate 10.5 55.5
rect 80 30
stroke 4
translate 100 0
rect 70 30 8
write

case paths

reset

case dotpaths
opt size 220 120
color #181818
dotpath 10 10 50 10 60 90 100 90
stroke 1.5
dotpath 110 10 120 80 150 20 160 90 170 100 190 30 210 60
color #FF0000
stroke 1 5 5
dotpath 10 100 60 60 120 110 200 100
write

case text-basic
opt size 260 120
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 Hello\sWorld\s(SansSerif\s12)
translate 0 18
text SansSerif 14 bold - #000000 - - 0 Bold\sparticipant\sname
translate 0 18
text SansSerif 13 italic - #181818 - - 0 Italic\smessage\stext\s0123456789
translate 0 18
text SansSerif 11 bolditalic - #A80036 - - 0 Bold\sitalic\s@#$%&*()[]{}
translate 0 18
text SansSerif 9 plain - #000000 - - 0 small\stext\sat\s9\spoints,\sfractional\spositions
translate 0 18
text SansSerif 18 plain - #3333AA - - 0 Large\sAgjpqy
write

case text-positions

text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 Hil\sat\s10.3,20.6

text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 Hil\sat\s10.7,40.2
reset
translate 10.5 60.5
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 Hil\sat\s10.5,60.5
reset
translate 120.49 80.51
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 Hil
write

case gradients

bg #FFFFFF|#3333FF

rect 50 40
translate 55 0

rect 50 40
reset
translate 10 60
bg #FFFF00|#FF00FF

translate 70 0
bg #00FFFF/#0000FF
polygon 0 0 0 60 0 30 50
translate 70 0
bg #FFFFFF-#000000
rect 60 50 10
write

case gradients-linear
opt size 230 120
color #181818
bg lg(0,0,1,0,false,PAD,0:#FF0000:1,0.5:#FFFF00:1,1:#0000FF:1)

rect 100 40
translate 110 0

reset

rect 100 50
translate 110 0
bg lg(0.25,0,0.5,0,false,REPEAT,0:#00FF00:1,1:#0000FF:1)
rect 100 50
write

case clip

case centered
opt size 200 60
# Upstream hints the glyphs drawn before the first text (fractional metrics
# off); a text first sets the hints DriverTextG2d leaves on, as in diagrams.
translate 150 55
text SansSerif 9 plain - #000000 - - 0 spots
reset
color #181818
bg #ADD1B2
translate 10 10
ellipse 22 22
color #000000
translate 11 11
centered C 17
reset
color #181818
bg #A9DCDF
translate 40 10
ellipse 22 22
color #000000
translate 11 11
centered I 17
reset
color #000000
translate 80 21
centered A 14 SansSerif bold
translate 30 0
centered E 17 Monospaced bold
translate 30 0
centered @ 12 Serif plain
write

translate 11 11

write

translate 20 0
line 40 80
aa on
reset
translate 70 10
line 0 80
write
